runs.text: Cash pooling is an arrangement between entities within the same business organi

ation. It presents their short term credit and debit cash balance positions as a net number. Pooling is normally effected through a bank which provides a single summary account with interest charged or earned on the net cash balance position. There is no movement of funds between accounts of the entities participating in the cash pool. While the accounts must be at the same bank they need not be in the same branch.
